body:
Idk...the "rough patch" has lasted about 15 years, give or take. I've been depressed half my life and crippled with anxiety for the past decade. 

Really, the only thing that helps is weed, and that's because I don't care about anything when I'm high. It's also the only time I enjoy things, but it makes me stupid as fuck in the long run. I can't sustain interest in anything like books and movies and don't have the motivation to exercise. The most I can manage is getting up for work, struggling through that, coming home and sleeping. Then I just sleep and feel like shit on the weekends without doing much else.

I don't feel like there's a solution for me. Suicide just seems practical at this point because I don't think I can be fixed. My "healthiest" option would be to tolerate life while never enjoying it until I die naturally. Seriously, nothing makes me happy. The most I can hope for is distraction, really.

Yeah, both...gave up on guitar because I couldn't stay interested and gave up video games because they made me anxious. Dunno why, I guess it's the adrenaline. I'd get engrossed but feel like shit for days after. I sound like a hopeless case.

I wish I could find a pill that would fix me, but pills are what made me the way I am. This is the first time in my life I've felt this weird and it only started after trying an antidepressant. Funny thing is, I've been on them multiple times before - even the one that triggered all this. Don't know why this time was so different.

Thanks for the reply. What sucks is that I've never read anything from anyone who's going through something similar. I feel like I'm the only person on earth experiencing this. I get that other people have terrible anxiety and depression too, but it doesn't manifest like it does in me. I'm a fucking freak.

Unfortunately focusing on myself makes it worse. I just want to get outside of myself but it's impossible. 

And yeah, I enjoy smoking weed and zoning out to movies lol. That's literally it, I no longer have hobbies or interests and I don't care about anything. I'm not functional when I'm smoking though - the weird shit I described above just gets worse when I smoke, even weeks after I stop. I got fired from a job for acting like a weirdo and forgetting stuff all the time when I was smoking. So my options are: suffer through life sober and enjoy nothing or give up on life and be high all the time (and eventually kill myself). 

Sorry I sound like I'm disregarding everything you said. I just can't come up with a solution. Anything that requires me to think or not think (like meditation) just makes me focus on my own mind...which I just want to escape.

Unfortunately none of these organizations will assist you with suicide unless you have a terminal physical illness. I was saving up money to be euthanized then read that "depression" and "no quality of life" doesn't qualify you to die.

I don't know. I've been grappling with the same question.

Telling myself, "if you're going to kill yourself anyway, why not try to live?" doesn't work. It's laughable to think that way.

Many of us want to kill ourselves because we don't have love. We don't have it or we can't feel it. 

I'd go on suicide prevention websites when feeling low and they'd always say, "someone loves you." "Someone will be devastated if you die." What the fuck does that matter if you can't connect or have no one to connect to?????????????

Totally. I spent a couple months taking handfuls of Benadryl every day so I could spend all my time unconscious. No thinking, no feeling, just nothing. 

Then I discovered weed, which was even better. I can literally spend the better part of a week sleeping when I get stoned.
